text.tspan: Tank V0 — how it works: technical view

svg.text: One Tank service, PostgreSQL and OpenMA in Docker on one Linux host. The service only reads; the agent sandboxes have open internet. Tank holds no exchange keys and cannot trade.
Source: 02 HLD v2.2 and 03 TDD (16 Oct 2026). Tank is one asyncio process built from modules; durable work is a job in ops.jobs; only sessions talks to OpenMA.
External source
Module of the Tank service · OpenMA
Storage
External service / LLM call
Telegram output
One polling loop per source: S01–S18, S20–S28, S30–S34 over plain
HTTP (conditional GET, 20 s timeout, 3 retries)
Raw payload + SHA-256 → raw/items; new item → source_items
+ FILTER_ITEM or ROUTE_ITEM job
S14: diff of the venues' instrument lists
One loop: Playwright (async API), headless Chromium; X profile in the
volume tank-browser, signed in from the secret x_session
X list (S29) read every 60 s; Franklin Templeton page (S19) rendered
every 600 s
Raw capture → source_items + FILTER_ITEM or ROUTE_ITEM job
Hot tier ≤ 15 tokens: one task per venue WebSocket, ≤ 135
subscriptions on ≈ 10 connections — trades, books, mark/funding,
liquidations; a trade-ID gap is backfilled over REST
In the same module: 1-min flow bars per venue (aggressor side, size
buckets, completeness), 10 s book summaries, hourly Parquet written
in a worker thread
Base tier: 22 tokens, 181 series — klines every 60 s, OI + funding every
A token turns hot → subscribed on every venue + backfill −24 h, −4 h,
−1 h · Binance archive files · DefiLlama daily · Etherscan balances
One loop: runs each source loop at its cadence, every 15 s while
escalated
Creates jobs: EVAL_CONDITIONS every minute, MILESTONE_CHECK
at a milestone's time, REACTION_CAPTURE at each checkpoint
Hot-set demotion · heartbeat 08:00 UTC · retention · nightly backup
(pg_dump and bundles/ to an external disk)
The jobs below, and the code behind the agent's tools: outlook, thesis
and trade grades, action, alert gate
Jobs of the agent's get_market_truth: tokens to the hot tier, then spot
flow, open interest, funding and liquidity per venue at one fixed time →
what moves the price; data confidence. Computed in a worker thread; the
result goes back to the session
Checks the armed conditions on new bars; a fired one →
CONDITION_FIRED into the event's session
At a vote end, effective date or launch time checks the official source →
MILESTONE into the session
Records the market at +15 m, +1 h, +4 h, +24 h, +72 h
Take the next due job from ops.jobs (official items and MAJOR+ work first), run it under its
timeout, write the result and the next job
On start, jobs left RUNNING by a stopped service go back to the queue
Jobs FILTER_ITEM and ROUTE_ITEM:
Asks Jev one yes/no question about each news item, GitHub commit and post of founders, C-level
and other accounts: is it about crypto? Above the cutoff (set at V0-B) → ROUTE_ITEM; below →
SKIPPED with its score
One event, one session. For each event with news in the last 3 days that shares an entity with the
item, Jev answers: the same event or a development of it? Best match above the cutoff →
ITEM_ADDED into that session; none → NEW_ITEM opens a new one (AGENT_MESSAGE job)
DELIVER jobs: Telegram sendMessage (HTML); updates as replies to the first card
Ledger out.deliveries: one row per transition; 5 attempts (1–16 s backoff), then FAILED +
DELIVERY_FAILED notice
The only module that talks to OpenMA. AGENT_MESSAGE jobs: NEW_ITEM opens a session;
ITEM_ADDED, CONDITION_FIRED, MILESTONE and CALL_EXPIRED go into the event's session.
While the agent works, sessions follows the session's stream and runs the tools it calls,
answering with user.custom_tool_result:
get_item · search_tank_items · list_open_events · get_event · get_registry ·
get_token_facts · web_search (DuckDuckGo) · fetch_page; pages and results stored as
evidence
record_event · add_observation · merge_into · set_assessment · set_beneficiaries
· schedule_milestone · propose_pattern. Quotes, stages, class checks and caps are code; a
bad input is refused with the reason
ESCALATE_TOKENS + RUN_MARKET_TRUTH jobs; the session waits and gets the result when the
job is done
Outlook, thesis and trade grades, action, watch conditions — code (TDD §4.8–§7)
Alert gate and update policy, template, evidence bundle (SHA-256) → DELIVER job; one lock per
event
On start: replays each open session from its last event; a tool call left without a result runs again
OpenAI Responses endpoint on tank:8790 behind
OpenMA's Model Card
Signs each call with the ChatGPT (Codex) token from the
volume codex-auth, refreshes it, forwards to OpenAI
Modules call each other directly · loops and stream tasks keep sources and markets read · work that must survive a restart is a job in ops.jobs, run by the service's own workers
ops.jobs — the service's job queue: FOR UPDATE SKIP
LOCKED, by priority

reaction checkpoints (append-only)

only

and tank-data (schema, APIs, rules) · Tank's custom tools + built-in bash, files, browser

call

Second agent tank-scout-reviewer reviews scout proposals
One microVM per session: the agent creates files and runs any command and script
